statement: Supermicro's board probe into a US indictment over roughly $2.5 billion of Nvidia GPU servers diverted to China found no current senior management knowledge and no direct sales to restricted parties, but led to terminations and an expanded export-compliance program.
why: A multi-billion-dollar diversion channel being shut down and compliance tightened removes a gray-market outlet for Nvidia systems and raises friction on China-bound shipments.

impact.mechanism: Tighter export-compliance enforcement at a major server builder closes an indirect China demand channel for Nvidia GPU systems.

evidence.excerpt: for violating export controls on approximately $2.5 billion in Nvidia GPU-equipped servers bound for China
had knowledge of the alleged diversion scheme or of any actual diversion.

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet; the fetched article did not reference the underlying SEC filing or a termination count.
